Tatlong round ng clearing operations ang inilunsad ng MMDA Special Operations Group-Task Force for Road Clearing sa bahagi ng Quezon City ngayong Martes, Hunyo 24.

Ikinasa ang unang operasyon sa G. Tuazon at Blumentritt kung saan 35 ang tiniketan habang 13 ang na-tow.

Sunod na inoperate ang North Avenue at Mindanao Avenue kung saan 14 ang naisyuhan ng citation tickets samantalang dalawang sasakyan ang nahatak.

Sa ikatlong strike, katuwang ang Quezon City Traffic & Transport Management Department (QC-TTMD), kabuuang 32 ang tiniketan habang 12 ang na-tow sa operasyon sa West Avenue.

Karamihan sa mga kalsadang inoperate ay kabilang sa mga complaint areas na idinaan sa 8888 hotline. 

#mmda 
#mmdaatyourservice

SUMABOG NA POWER BANK

A power bank caught fire and exploded at the security screening checkpoint of Roxas Airport in Capiz on Tuesday, June 24, the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines reported.

The 72,000 mAh device, which exceeded the 160 watt-hour limit, was detected inside the baggage of a female passenger bound for Manila. 

"The passenger initially claimed that the power bank had been allowed on her inbound flight from Manila, but eventually agreed to turn the item over to a companion outside the terminal," CAAP said in a statement. 

CAAP said that while arrangements were being made to surrender the power bank, it suddenly ignited and exploded.

No one was injured and no significant damage was reported in the incident.  

📸 Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines
